episode_title: AI Is Exposing a Massive Problem With B2B Marketing Data

real_qa.q: Why does pointing AI directly at CRM and marketing tool data fail to produce reliable marketing reports?
real_qa.r: Connecting systems is not one thing but a whole web of smaller things that must line up correctly. Contacts, campaigns, and relationships between records across different systems often break silently without throwing errors or alerts. AI will confidently give answers based on broken underlying data connections without knowing the foundation is unreliable, which is the real risk.

real_qa.q: What percentage of companies have undetected contact matching problems across their marketing and CRM systems?

real_qa.q: How should marketing leaders test whether their contact records are properly connected between marketing automation and CRM?
